categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Addresses PSBT data overpopulation in RPC methods descriptorprocesspsbt and utxoupdatepsbt, with regression tests in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where RPC methods combining multiple descriptors leak unrelated MuSig2 participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into PSBT inputs and outputs. While MuSig2 descriptor workflows are specialized, preventing exposure of sensitive participant data and ensuring correctness of returned PSBTs warrants deliberate review under the RPC category.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies src/script/sign.cpp and test/functional/rpc_psbt.py without touching wallet code or wallet-specific interfaces.
categories.rationale: Per the wallet category definition, descriptor or PSBT changes that affect RPC without wallet code belong to rpc, not wallet.
